title: Shared Horizon
direction:
Concept label "01 / SHARED HORIZON".
Visual personality: the most polished corporate interpretation of the user's flat-top SFT idea. A wide, elegant joined SFT monogram constructed from medium-weight uniform strokes and generous negative space, the S squared at its upper edge with carefully rounded lower transitions; the flat upper edges of S, F and T join into a single designed horizontal rhythm. Readable, quiet authority, exceptional restraint, no underline/accent spark. Strong navy #15324D, ice blue, off-white, selective cobalt. Product icons share precise open geometric strokes on soft translucent colored tiles. Hero artwork: a sweeping architectural arrangement of precision-cut cobalt and frosted-glass ribbons, with believable material and soft daylight, the monogram's horizontal/curved shapes repeated in three-dimensional space. Clean white editorial board with substantial breathing room. This should be a finished-looking design exploration, not technical construction lines.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one highly polished landscape identity presentation board for SureForgeTech, an original software publisher with nine products, for an audience spanning creative individual builders and enterprise engineers. It should feel secure, competent, sophisticated, and approachable. Art-direct this like a leading branding studio; a striking visual identity, not a website wireframe or a collection of text boxes.

Board composition: large master logo specimen occupying the upper-left with the exact company wordmark "SureForgeTech". The master logo must combine ALL THREE uppercase letters S, F, and T into ONE thoughtfully designed ligature/monogram, sharing intentional strokes and negative space. S has a flat horizontal top aligned with the flat tops of F and T. All three must remain identifiable. Custom designed lettering, excellent optical spacing, balanced weights, simple enough for one-color reproduction. Not an S-only logo. No extra fourth letter. Do not simply type SFT in an ordinary font or mechanically superimpose letters.
Upper-right: one visually rich brand illustration / campaign artwork showing how this specific logo geometry becomes an expressive website hero image. This should be beautiful imagery, not word-filled shapes or a flowchart.
Lower region: EXACTLY NINE distinct product icons in a well-spaced horizontal strip or 3x3 grouping, each with its correct short product name, sharing a clear style but different functional pictograms and accent colors. The nine labels in order are "Agent", "Studio", "Policy", "Trellis", "Capture", "Terminal", "FM Data API", "FM Snippets", "Flow".
Icon meanings: Agent = AI coding assistant and guided work, Studio = multi-repository workstation, Policy = security and compliance, Trellis = Jira hierarchy/planning, Capture = narrated macOS testing (waveform/capture), Terminal = native macOS SSH console, FM Data API = structured database/API, FM Snippets = reusable text snippets, Flow = multi-tenant application platform. Do NOT make nine identical icons with different initials. Distinguish Agent from Terminal and Data API from Snippets.
Also include small monochrome/reversed master-logo samples and 3-5 palette swatches. Keep text minimal and accurate, no paragraphs or claims. Top small label should show the concept number and title specified below.

Avoid: any competitor logo or imitation; generic shield/padlock; hammers/anvils; orbiting circles/network nodes; cyber-hacker aesthetics; arbitrary sparkle glued to the logo; UI screenshots; stock business people; certification badges; legal entity suffixes; trademark symbols; slogans claiming certified security. The master logo is flat vector-like artwork, not 3D. The brand illustration can be rich, dimensional, and artistic. All elements original.

title: Interlock
direction:
Concept label "02 / INTERLOCK".
Visual personality: engineered trust through interlocking form. A compact, memorable SFT monogram created from three substantial continuous bands with deliberate over-under joints and negative-space letter recognition, not literal chain links. Each letter legible within the whole; all three flat aligned cap edges. Jade #0B795E, near-black spruce #122B26, mist ivory, pale mint. Mark can be one color and must look stable, clever, and timeless. Product icon family uses rounded corners and interlocking two-part shapes with distinctive functional silhouettes, muted jewel tones. Hero artwork: macro studio rendering of a beautifully crafted interlocking structure made from matte jade ceramic and brushed pale aluminum, warm grazing light emphasizing fit and craftsmanship. No circles or nodes. Strong contrast with a quiet ivory board and dark hero field. More human, tactile, and approachable than a cybersecurity vendor.

title: Facet
direction:
Concept label "03 / FACET".
Visual personality: crisp, premium, technologically advanced. ONE compact angular SFT ligature made with interwoven folded planes, consistent 45-degree cuts, deliberate flat cap alignment and clear negative-space S, F and T. Strong original silhouette, avoid hexagonal H marks and generic shields. Deep ink #151A34, electric ultramarine #4355F9, icy lavender, warm white. Parent mark primarily monochrome; color accents at plane junctions only. Product icons share faceted angular geometry but each has a recognizable unique symbol and product-specific color. Hero artwork: dramatic architectural paper-and-metal sculpture formed from large folded planes, ultramarine and white with subtle iridescent edges and realistic hard/soft shadow interplay, striking close crop with quiet negative space. Poster-like confident composition, sophisticated and corporate, no text-filled shapes.

title: Humanist
direction:
Concept label "04 / HUMANIST".
Visual personality: warm, approachable software craftsmanship with enterprise-quality finish. Custom uppercase SFT monogram with broad rounded internal corners, flat upper cap edges, joined fluid letter strokes and optically open counters; friendly but not bubbly or childish, all THREE letters visibly present in one mark. Ink navy #203248, warm vermilion #DA604B, soft peach and cream. No shield, brackets, spark, underline, badge or frame around logo. Nine icons have charming individually recognizable functional silhouettes made from one or two curved ribbon shapes, vivid but mature colors, no letters. Hero artwork: an exuberant yet orderly composition of richly colored sculptural ribbons resembling precision-cut paper or satin-finish enamel, flowing together into a strong elegant structure; warm studio illumination, expressive sense of useful creative energy. Bright cream board, excellent typography, design-publisher personality. The composition must look clearly different from dark infrastructure branding.

title: Precision Foundry
direction:
Concept label "05 / PRECISION FOUNDRY".
Visual personality: premium industrial precision, established corporate authority with modern engineering. A bold, wide SFT monogram as ONE machined typographic unit; each letter is custom-cut with a common flat upper rail, squared S with subtle corner radii, crisp F and T, negative spaces doing the clever work. Highly readable and eye-catching; avoids the look of a normal typed abbreviation and does not add a badge. Graphite #20242A, burnished copper #B87748, pale stone #EAE6DE, cool steel. Product icons are elegant three-dimensional enamel/inlaid-glyph app icons with nine different functional symbols and restrained gemstone accents, related chamfers and consistent lighting. Hero artwork: a luxurious macro still-life of a precision-milled copper and graphite structure derived from the SFT mark, rich physical detail, beautiful highlights, tactile metal, deep shadows, no literal anvil or workshop tools. Board uses stone background plus charcoal hero field, confident sparse editorial hierarchy.

title: Spectrum
direction:
Concept label "06 / SPECTRUM".
Visual personality: a distinctive multi-product software publisher that can grow. Original SFT monogram made from a small family of bold modular shapes; the three letters lock together in one clear silhouette with flat upper edges, mostly black/ink with selectively placed bright cobalt, coral and chartreuse modules. It must work in one color and not resemble JetBrains black-square tiles, Figma stacked circles, or any other competitor mark. White, midnight ink #162337, cobalt #3974EF, apricot #F38A67, lime #B9D653. Product icon family is highly differentiated: nine fresh sculptural pictograms, all built from the same rounded-rectangular and angled parts; each product has its own dominant color, polished macOS-quality depth and visual charm. Hero artwork: a delightful premium studio arrangement of these abstract modular parts, some assembled into purposeful forms, on a crisp white stage with vivid soft shadows and controlled color. No orbiting around a central logo. Bold visual interest with corporate-grade restraint. This option should most clearly communicate a family of individual useful apps.
